summary: Core workflow and legacy regressions pass 19 emulator tests; deployment remains blocked by incomplete assignment eligibility, migration and public-content isolation.

findings.issue: Active enrollment authorizes all published assignments; assignment-specific eligibility is not enforced.
findings.recommendation: Add trusted course or student assignment membership and emulator coverage.

findings.issue: Existing Math Chapter 5 submission path is denied by existing and draft rules.
findings.recommendation: Complete reviewed migration or explicit legacy support before rollout.

findings.issue: Responses have a count limit but nested fields have no individual schema or length bounds.
findings.recommendation: Define and enforce bounded response/work/check schemas.

findings.issue: Published assignment metadata could contain protected questions or keys; legacy Canada questions are statically public.
findings.recommendation: Audit content and prohibit protected material in public metadata/assets; preserve legacy behavior only as an explicit migration decision.
